# X-Dynasty

|birth_place=Ikeja, Nigeria|education=Olabisi Onabanjo University|occupation=Online streamer, YouTuber, Content creator|years_active=2021-Present}}
Olayiwola Oluwatobiloba Victor (born November 15, 2003), known online as X-Dynasty, is a Nigerian online streamer, YouTuber and content creator. He gained internet relevance mid-2025 during a viral livestream when he founded a philosophy he termed as NUMB after he was bailed from an arrest where he was charged with assault.
Early life and Education
Victor was born 15th of November, 2003 in Ikeja, Lagos to Nigerian parents. He spent his early childhood in Lagos before his family relocated to Ogun State at just eight years old. After his father left for the diaspora, Victor was solely raised by his mother and largely under the care of an extended family member.
Growing up, Victor (according to research) was known as a violent, suicidal and emotionally disturbed child. He was known for his aggressiveness and intolerance towards others. Victor prior to his toxic attitude was also known to have been lonely and a victim of sexual assault. He studied Economics at Olabisi Onabanjo University where his content journey started.
Career
Victor started creating content in 2021 in the university originally due to depression.
The NUMB Philosophy
In mid-2025 after Victor was bailed due to an arrest of he being charged with assault, he delivered a viral livestream which he created a philosophy he called NUMB, encouraging followers to develop emotional resilience and stay unshaken amidst life challenges. The stream became a turning point in his career, leading him to internet relevance and gaining a growing digital cult-following among his audience and also critics questioning the genuinity of his motives .
